title: Findings hold on a review tick re-dispatches the review on resume instead of closing behind its recorded decision
body: findings.go:201-207 tells the operator that after triage 'the close is the only step left', but closeRoleTick (rolejob.go:303-307) marks the tick rejected and on resume processRoleJob -> claimDispatch never reads the recorded role decision, so a zero-commit review is re-dispatched: epic-ncv ran pxc attempts 9, 10 and 11 on byte-identical source. Each re-dispatch pays for a new review, can raise new findings and so a new hold (the loop ends only when a reviewer reports nothing), and recordDecision's role+tick dedup (rolejob.go:224-229) leaves decisions/ holding attempt 9's answer while a later attempt's closes the tick. No test resumes a triaged role tick.
